facts.fact: Horizons reports the official launch on 16 February 2025 of electronic certification and signature services for businesses by the AECE, with three certificate types (ThequaSign, Thequa ID, Thequa entreprise), a certification authority operational since 2021 and the first token handed over.

DZA.note: The document states nothing on a data protection law.

facts.fact: Horizons says law 15-04 of 1 February 2015 governs electronic signature and certification in Algeria, and the AECE director says it leaves the choice between handwritten and electronic signature.
Horizons reports that under law 15-04 the AECE, the economic certification authority supervised by the ARPCE, launched certification services for businesses on 16 February 2025, operating since 2021.

DZA.note: The certificates are offered to economic operators; the document names no government service portal or online service.
